exposure: combined intra-gestational and systemic methotrexate injection
ultrasound-guided transvaginal intra-gestational methotrexate injection (100 mg)
fetal intracardiac potassium chloride (if cardiac activity present)
outcome: resolution of hCG levels without emergency surgery
cohort: Twenty patients with non-tubal ectopic pregnancies (NTEP), including cesarean scar, cervical, and interstitial types.
finding: Combined intra-gestational and systemic methotrexate treatment for non-tubal ectopic pregnancies demonstrated a 95% success rate in resolving hCG levels without emergency surgery, proving to be a safe, effective, and fertility-sparing approach with promising future pregnancy outcomes.
